I am a researcher (Ph.D.) specializing in **time-series and spectral analysis of groundwater-level and hydrological data (FFT, wavelet, cross-correlation)** and **geochemical modeling (PHREEQC)**. From hands-on graduate courses to technical guidance and contract/collaborative research, I help teams make sense of real data. Available in both English and Japanese.

## What I Offer

```{=html}
<div class="svc-grid">
  <div class="svc-card">
    <h4>🎓 Intensive Courses &amp; Hands-on Workshops</h4>
    <p>Practical training in <strong>PHREEQC (geochemical modeling)</strong> and <strong>time-series &amp; spectral analysis of hydrological data (FFT, wavelet)</strong> for graduate students and labs, over one to a few days. Built on the DeepFlows tutorial series, hands-on.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="svc-card">
    <h4>🛠️ Technical Guidance &amp; Modeling Support</h4>
    <p>I take on — or work alongside you on — the modeling part of your research project, including untangling where students get stuck.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="svc-card">
    <h4>📊 Contract &amp; Collaborative Research</h4>
    <p><strong>Time-series analysis of groundwater-level &amp; hydrological data</strong> (tidal/barometric response, hydraulic conductivity &amp; diffusivity estimation, FFT, wavelet, cross-correlation), and <strong>geochemistry</strong> (water-quality formation, water–rock interaction, geothermal / CO2).</p>
  </div>
  <div class="svc-card">
    <h4>🎤 Talks &amp; Seminars</h4>
    <p>Invited talks and seminars for study groups, conferences, and companies — technical topics made clear.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="svc-card">
    <h4>🐍 Data Analysis &amp; Visualization</h4>
    <p><strong>Time-series &amp; spectral analysis (FFT, wavelet)</strong>, spatial interpolation, and figure preparation in Python, shaped for research and reporting.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Who It's For

- University labs and graduate students (learning modeling, or needing it for a project)
- Research institutes and government agencies (groundwater & geochemistry analysis)
- Companies in the environmental, geothermal, and water-resources sectors

## Credentials

- Ph.D. in Science / **26 peer-reviewed papers** (14 as first author)
- Expertise: time-series &amp; spectral analysis of groundwater-level and hydrological data (FFT, wavelet, cross-correlation, tidal/barometric response), geochemical modeling (PHREEQC), water–rock interaction (geothermal / CO2)
